# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 45 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic Equivalence)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 45 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_045_page_001.jpg

---

## Mandate 12, Part 2 — God Is Powerful Enough to Help You Keep These Commands

**45:1** He said to me: "You know that you are God's servant and you live under his lordship. His power is immense — beyond comprehension. He created everything from nothing. He alone holds all things together, and nothing can hold him.

**45:2** So have faith in him and fear him. Let that fear produce self-control in you. Keep all these things, and drive every evil desire away from yourself. Clothe yourself instead in every good and holy desire. If you keep these commandments, you will truly live for God."

**45:3** "Lord," I said, "I need you to strengthen me — I have so many distractions. The world pulls at me, the devil pulls at me, people with power over the living and the dead pull at me. There are so many diversions carrying me off course." "I know," he said. "But I will be with you and will rescue you from all of it. Just keep my commandments and you won't be handed over to them. Trust God — he will rescue you."

**45:4** "I do trust him, lord," I said. "Then why don't you fear him too?" he asked. "Since you trust him." "Lord," I said, "your commandments are great, good, and glorious — they have the power to save a person's soul. But when someone realizes how demanding they are, and their heart has grown hard toward God and their weakness is great — they despair. They tell themselves: these commands are just too hard; I can't do this. Their heart hardens further and they walk away from the living God."

**45:5** "Those thoughts come from the devil," he said — "the one who opposes your Lord. Don't let thoughts like that get a foothold in your heart. Don't waver and think you can't keep these commandments. Instead, think about the One who can do all things — the One who accomplishes everything according to his will. His power is immense and his glory is immense. He is fully capable of fulfilling all these things in you. So trust God. Believe in him."

---

*PNEUMA renders for contemporary clarity and accessibility, capturing the pastoral encouragement at the heart of Mandate 12.*
